result.title: Putin and Zelensky agree to resume Ukraine talks
result.summary: Putin has agreed to resume trilateral talks on the Ukraine war involving Kyiv and Washington, according to the Kremlin. Zelensky says Ukraine supports a ceasefire and is ready to freeze the conflict along the current front line, while US envoy Steve Witkoff met Putin in St. Petersburg for talks on Ukraine and the Persian Gulf.

result.title: Ramaswamy ad featuring Acton's estranged mother sparks row
result.summary: Ohio gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy has run a campaign ad featuring the estranged mother of his Democratic rival, Amy Acton, who alleges childhood abuse. The ad has drawn criticism from voters and some Republicans, while JD Vance has defended it and criticised the GOP pushback, and Acton has called the ad horrible.

result.title: Ebola outbreak spreads from Congo to Africa
result.summary: An Ebola outbreak that began in Congo has spread to several African countries, including Nigeria and Kenya, where patients and high-risk contacts have been identified and quarantined. Nigerian authorities say an imported patient is recovering, that there is no evidence of community transmission yet, and that 46 Ebola contacts have been barred from flying. The United States is set to require an attestation from international air passengers related to the outbreak.
